title: Royal Ballistix — Beach Siege
description: Radial ball-deflection survival for 2–10 contestants, one local human plus bots. Radial touch movement controls running alongside Magnet and Pulse; keyboard controls, adjustable arena and CAM save/load remain available. The quality revision improves contact, input cleanup, round results and landscape layout. Phone/network transport is not integrated.
